name: ready-check
description: Prepaid email inspection for agents: structured findings on one inbound email.
long_description: Ready Check by ReadyUpAgents inspects one inbound email's text and returns structured findings (kind, verdict, scores, named checks). It does not write a reply, connect to an inbox, or send mail. A standard check costs $0.0025; credit comes in $1 and $5 packs paid by card on Stripe Checkout.

ready_check_key.description: Your prepaid Ready Check key (rc_ + 43 URL-safe base64 characters). Leave empty until you buy your first pack.
